approved_libraries: Python standard library (csv, json, math, statistics)

instrument.name: X-band CW-EPR

read-export.reason: Both registered fixtures use the local CSV reader.

measure-linewidth.reason: The simulator exports a field-swept derivative trace.

fit-curie.reason: The workspace includes a synthetic, pre-integrated intensity series with absolute temperatures.

pulse-acquisition.reason: This file-only CW simulator has no pulse or acquisition interface.

vendor-binary.reason: No vendor binary parser has been qualified for this profile.

instrument.reference_scope: Bruker primer §2.7 describes derivative linewidth and integration. Instrument identity, formats and capabilities here apply solely to the local simulator.

project.name: Temperature dependence
project.description: Fit integrated intensity against inverse absolute temperature to recover a Curie coefficient and background.
project.contract: Use statistics.linear_regression with x=1/T and y=integrated intensity. Return coefficient_au_K, background_au, and rmse_au. No weighting. Include arrays predicted_au and residual_au in input row order (residual = measured minus predicted).
project.human: Assess model suitability, normalization, saturation and the comparability of integrated intensities across temperatures.

extensions.fit-quality: Also return r_squared, the unweighted coefficient of determination computed as 1 - RSS/TSS for nonconstant intensities. Document constant-intensity handling.

human: Transfer to measured spectra and instrument calibration
